resources.string: Changes how emoji look in the keyboard only. The app you type in shows them with its own emoji font: what you send is the same emoji. The emoji style is separate from the keyboard\'s colors.
Noto Color Emoji (Google\'s Noto Emoji project, SIL Open Font License 1.1) is downloaded from %1$s and checked before use. Nothing you type is sent.
